id.description: Unique configuration ID within this workspace folder.

name.description: Name shown in the Preview picker.

previewID.description: Optional exact compiled #Preview ID. Omit to select a declaration after building the app.

project.description: Xcode project path, relative to this workspace folder.

workspace.description: Xcode workspace path, relative to this workspace folder.

target.description: Application target. Required when the scheme builds multiple apps.

arguments.description: Host arguments. No shell interpretation is performed.

buildArguments.description: Additional KEY=VALUE Xcode build settings. Product identity, destination, and output directory overrides are rejected.

developerDirectory.description: Optional Xcode Contents/Developer directory used for build and Simulator tools.
